mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_user_behavior (user_id, item_id, item_type, behavior_type, keywords) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, #{itemType}, #{behaviorType}, #{keywords})
mapper.select: SELECT item_type, item_id, keywords, COUNT(*) AS freq FROM ai_user_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY item_type, item_id, keywords ORDER BY freq DESC LIMIT #{limit}
